sections.subhead: Beyond Themes and Plugins — WordPress Built Around How Your Business Actually Works

body.html: Custom WordPress Development Kochi is what Teknoppy delivers when an off-the-shelf theme and a handful of plugins aren't enough to run your business anymore. Some sites need custom booking logic, member-only content, unusual data structures, or a workflow no plugin was built to handle. That's the gap this service closes — WordPress stretched and rebuilt around what your business specifically needs, not what a plugin marketplace happens to offer.

Businesses across Kochi increasingly reach the limits of a standard WordPress setup once operations get more complex — and that's exactly when Custom WordPress Development Kochi work becomes worth the investment over patching together more plugins.

sections.h2: Frequently Asked Questions — Custom WordPress Development Kochi

items.q: What counts as "custom" WordPress development versus a regular build?
items.a: Custom development means writing code specifically for your business logic — a booking system, a custom post type, or an integration — rather than configuring an existing theme or plugin to approximate what you need. Custom WordPress development Kochi projects typically start once a standard setup can no longer keep up with what the business needs.

items.q: Can you integrate WordPress with software we already use?
items.a: Yes. Our WordPress API integration Kochi work regularly connects WordPress to CRMs, accounting tools, booking platforms, and other business software through APIs.

items.q: Will custom code break when WordPress updates?
items.a: Not if it's built correctly. We follow WordPress coding standards specifically so custom features remain stable through core and plugin updates, rather than needing constant fixes.

items.q: Do you build fully custom plugins, or only modify existing ones?
items.a: Both, depending on the need. Some projects need a small, purpose-built plugin from scratch; others just need an existing plugin extended. We'll recommend whichever is more maintainable for you long-term.

items.q: How do you scope a custom development project before starting?
items.a: We start with a requirements mapping session to document exactly what the current site can't do, then scope each custom WordPress functionality piece individually so there are no surprises mid-project.

items.q: Who maintains the custom code after launch?
items.a: You can maintain it in-house if you have the resources, or add it to our WordPress Maintenance Services plan — either way, full documentation is provided at handover so nothing depends on us alone.
